title: 31 January 1963: Live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
content:
The Beatles’ 275th known Cavern Club performance took place on this day. It was the last of six shows at the venue in January 1963

The precise number of The Beatles’ Cavern performances is not known, although they played at least 155 lunchtime and 125 evening shows. Their final performance at the underground venue took place on 3 August 1963.

This was the group’s 154th lunchtime performance at the venue. In the evening they played two shows at the Majestic Hall, Birkenhead.

Page last updated: 25 January 2024

Also on this day...

  • 2013: Stella McCartney creates Beatles t-shirts for Red Nose Day 2013
  • 2010: The Beatles win Grammy Award for All Together Now
  • 1980: John Lennon and Yoko Ono purchase Palm Beach property
  • 1977: Recording: Out On The Streets, Can She Do It Like She Dances? by Ringo Starr
  • 1976: Recording: She’s My Baby, The Note You Never Wrote, Time To Hide by Wings
  • 1975: Recording: Listen To What The Man Said, My Carnival, Crossroads by Wings
  • 1975: UK single release: #9 Dream by John Lennon
  • 1972: Paul McCartney writes Give Ireland Back To The Irish
  • 1970: Ringo and Maureen fly from Las Vegas to Los Angeles
  • 1969: Get Back/Let It Be sessions: day 22
  • 1967: Filming: Strawberry Fields Forever
  • 1964: The Beatles live: Olympia Theatre, Paris
  • 1963: The Beatles live: Majestic Ballroom, Birkenhead
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (evening)
